quote: Questions of justice run through every position. Advanced genetic therapies are among the most expensive treatments ever devised, and there is a real fear of a world stratified into the genetically privileged and everyone else, sometimes called a genetic underclass, whether within Australia or between rich and poor nations. Some respond that fairness depends on policy rather than technology: a one-time curative edit could cost the health system less than a lifetime of managing sickle cell disease, and public funding through Medicare could make access equitable, just as it has for earlier innovations.
